visual_review: Lead review of real engine captures (not the concept image). Better than before: licensed car with panel gaps, interior and Turkish-layout plate; mosque with relief, drum, turrets and fluted minarets; 3D bridge, far shore and ferry; houses with casings, shutters, awnings; wet road mirrors lamps and mosque at night; HUD with live data. Still weak, not accepted as final: houses read plain in daylight from 8-40 m, roofs are slabs; mosque stone is flat cream by day; no spectators (flat cards removed as toy-like); no rain beads on paint; player and rivals are licensed cars now; amber indicators do not glow. Gate score by the lead about 72/100, target 90 not reached. The owner decides acceptance.
device: Desktop PC, Windows 11, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8 GB, 1920x1080, High preset. Not an iPhone measurement.
perf_note: Night gameplay shot with 3 licensed rivals (bench_night_gameplay.json): 185.7 fps average, frame 5.39 ms avg, 6.92 ms p95, 397 draw calls, 398640 primitives. Day gameplay 281 fps / 3.56 ms, sunset 153 fps / 6.54 ms. Peak over all 15 benchmark shots: 397 draws, 411001 primitives (budget 500 / 450000). Uncapped desktop numbers over 60 frames, other programs running; they say nothing about iPhone.
